items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: Good while before John Porter died. He gave it to me.

ctx.x: The bass. The dive on the bass.

The violin player has his hat on his toe. I can't tell where it is. Is that a wall in the background or a house? It's hard to see if that's something that's faded than back. make out where that was is that it looks like it might be outdoors. It looks like it's right by the levee to me. I can't tell it could be a levee yeah I don't know. That's the only kind of hills we have right here. Or it could be a wall I don't know it's hard to see. Not by the levee. You don't think it's a levee? The wall. And that was taken…

That's a pretty good age too. You can tell by the rum. Oh yes you can tell. It's very old. Yeah. I just wondered if you had it since it was taken about that time when you were young. No. I got it about five years ago. A friend of mine. I see if I know anybody on there. Yeah I wonder if Orrey has. I bet Orrey doesn't even have a picture or a copy of that. I'm sure he ain't. I bet sure he's not. You'd be surprised to see himself.

items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: John Porter's brother, he's Joe Porter.

ctx.x: Now this guy here, we used to call him Nug. He's got one hand, that's all I've been known. That's the only name. And he was a bass drum player. Bass drum player. John Porter's brother, he's Joe Porter. Cornet. Second, second cornet. Floyd Jackson, bass player. David Jones, I know you heard of him.
Oh yes, he's out in California.
